fullDescription: A high-tech, minimalist 'Agentic' aesthetic optimized for SaaS and AI platforms. This style guide features an obsidian dark mode (#0a0a0a) with vibrant neon lime (#ccff00) accents. It utilizes Space Grotesk for editorial typography and JetBrains Mono for a developer-centric feel. Key elements include glassmorphism with 16px blur, a 60x60px grid background pattern, grain texture overlays, and cinematic scroll-triggered animations. Suitable for fintech, developer tools, AI agents, and high-performance cloud infrastructure brands.

structured.summary: A futuristic, cinematic landing page design for technical products, characterized by obsidian depth, neon accents, and interactive agentic simulations. The layout emphasizes clarity, speed, and sophisticated automation through fluid SVG animations and glassmorphic UI components.

style.description: The style is 'Obsidian Tech-Minimalism'. It pairs the modern geometric 'Space Grotesk' typeface with a functional 'JetBrains Mono' for technical metadata. The color palette is strictly limited to deep black, shades of gray, and a singular, high-energy neon lime accent (#ccff00). Visual depth is achieved through 16px backdrop-blurs, 5% opacity grid patterns, and an overlay grain texture for a cinematic, non-digital look.
style.prompt: Create a design system using an Obsidian (#0a0a0a) background with Neon Lime (#ccff00) as the primary action color. Typography: Use 'Space Grotesk' for headings (weights 500, 700) with tight tracking (-0.05em) and 'JetBrains Mono' (400) for labels. Background components: A 60px grid pattern at 5% opacity and a subtle SVG grain texture overlay at 15% opacity using 'mix-blend-mode: overlay'. UI Cards: Use glassmorphism with background color rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03), a backdrop-filter blur of 16px, and a 1px border of rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08). Buttons: Primary buttons in solid #ccff00 with black text; secondary buttons are glassmorphic with thin white borders. Accents: Neon glows (box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(204, 255, 0, 0.3)) and gradient blurs in the background using lime, orange, and cyan at very low opacities (5-10%).

layout_and_structure.description: A vertical modular layout with a centered focus. It transitions from a cinematic hero with an interactive terminal simulation to a balanced feature grid, a sequential process section, and a hub-and-spoke integration map.

prompts.prompt: Sticky header at top:0 with a max-width 7xl container. Use a glassmorphic pill-shaped navigation bar (rounded-full) with 'REIGN.' logo on the far left (heavy weight, tracking-tight) and a 'Book a Demo' primary button on the right. Links in the center should be text-gray-400 with #ccff00 hover transitions.

Centered layout. Top badge: pill-shaped, JetBrains Mono font, v2.0 label with a pulsing #ccff00 dot. Main Heading: text-6xl to 8xl, font-bold, leading-0.9, using a vertical gradient from white to gray-500. Subtext: max-width 2xl, text-gray-400. Below text, an interactive 16:9 glassmorphic console showing a simulated cursor movement and typewriter animation typing 'Schedule meeting...'. The console should sit on a multi-color gradient glow (#ccff00, orange, cyan) at 30% opacity.

4-column grid layout for desktop. Each card is glassmorphic with 32px padding and 24px rounded corners. Icons should be neon lime (#ccff00) at 4xl size. Include a bottom border animation: a 4px lime line that expands from 0 to 100% width on hover.

A centralized hub-and-spoke visualization. Central circle is a glassmorphic 'HUB' with a neon lime glow. Radiating from it are 8 SVG paths connecting to individual app icons (Slack, Notion, Discord, etc.). SVG paths should use 'stroke-dasharray' and 'stroke-dashoffset' to create a flowing animation effect from the hub to the nodes.

prompts.prompt: Full-width section with a top border in white/10. Large 7xl heading 'Start automating today'. Footer is a simple horizontal layout with the logo, copyright, and social icons (Twitter, GitHub) that transition to neon lime on hover.

special_ui_components.description: A glassmorphic mock interface simulating AI reasoning.
special_ui_components.prompt: A 16:9 aspect ratio container with 'glass' styling. Top bar features three colored dots (red, yellow, green at 50% opacity) and a mono-spaced label 'REIGN_CORE_CONSOLE'. Inside, a terminal input field with a blinking #ccff00 cursor and typewriter text effect. A simulated cursor (lucide:cursor-arrow) moves autonomously using a 10s infinite cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) animation path.

special_ui_components.description: Animated SVG paths representing data flow.
special_ui_components.prompt: SVG paths connecting a central node to peripheral icons. Use 'stroke-dasharray: 100' and a CSS keyframe animation 'flow-line' that moves 'stroke-dashoffset' from 100 to 0. Vary colors between #ccff00, #ff6b00 (orange), and #00e5ff (cyan) to represent different data types.
